description: Attach artwork 'QA-CTX15 Global Option Test Artwork' (id 4167) to printarea 'Front' (id 13959) of product base 'QA - product base explore' (id 3203) inside campaign 'QA-CTX15 Global Option Test Campaign' (id 2605)

entries.label: mapped
entries.note: Full chain confirmed: campaign(2605) -> printarea(13959, product 3203) -> artwork(4167) -> layer(text-to-image) -> global_option(862). campaign.status=0 observed here — interpreted as draft/unlaunched (not confirmed against an enum source, OBSERVED_CURRENT only). After this call, portal UI banner changed from 'Your campaign is NOT ready to launch' to 'Your campaign is valid and ready to launch!' and PERSONALIZATION FORM panel showed 'Fields from artwork: QA-CTX15 Global Option Test Artwork' with a 'Generate image' button matching the text-to-image layer's GenAI flow.

prerequisite_fix_note: Getting to this state required 2 prior configuration steps outside the campaign editor itself, both on the product base (id 3203) 'QA - product base explore': (1) the product's printarea was initially 'connected to no variant or unavailable variant' and both existing variants (Black/M, White/L) showed 'No printareas' in their Custom Printareas column; unchecking the product's 'Custom variant's printarea' checkbox (Variants section) made both variants inherit the product-level 'Front' printarea, resolving the block. (2) 'Assign mockups' (Select all variants + Select all mockups + Save) was used to link the mockup image to the variants for STEP 2 preview. Recorded as portal UI/setup observation — not a Global Option finding, but necessary context for anyone reproducing this campaign fixture.
